title: 10 Best AI Tools for Non-Technical Teams (2026)
summary: The best AI tools non-technical teams actually use in 2026 — from writing and design to building custom apps. No code, no IT ticket. Verified by real team use.
body_markdown: ChatGPT is a conversation — you ask questions and get text responses. An AI app builder produces a real piece of software: a database, a UI, authentication, and hosted infrastructure. ChatGPT can't store your team's data persistently or let multiple people log in and track records. Blink builds software that does those things. They solve different problems — most teams use both. Start with ChatGPT for writing; reach for Blink when you need a real workflow tool.
